The Open Case Studies project was previously funded by the following grants:

1) The [Bloomberg American Health Initiative](https://americanhealth.jhu.edu/) funded the initial public health focused case studies with one of the [High-Impact Project Awards](https://americanhealth.jhu.edu/high-impact-project). PI: Stephanie Hicks, awarded 2019

2) The Digital Education Learning Technology Acceleration (DELTA) grant form the Johns Hopkins University Office of the Provost for our proposal entitled [Accessible experiential lesson guide delivery platform](https://provost.jhu.edu/about/digital-initiatives/delta/2020-delta-awards/). PI: Carrie Wright, awarded 2020


**Current Funding**: 
Open Case Studies is currently funded by the National Institute of General Medical Sciences: Grant Number [1R25GM160622](https://reporter.nih.gov/search/6Yy21_RclU2CB6Pq1F1ciQ/project-details/11216870) PIs: Carrie Wright and Ava Hoffman, awarded 2025
